q: What carbon figure should a West African builder ask its cement supplier for?
title: West African cement buyers: what to ask
short: Kg CO2 per tonne of the actual cement product, not just clinker, for a stated year, with the clinker share and whether captive power is included. Blended cements with more limestone or slag can be well below ordinary Portland cement, so ask per product. Use it for your project or Scope 3 figure.
audience: Contractors, developers and precast makers in Nigeria, Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire

ul: CO2 per tonne by cement type.
Whether it is cradle to gate and includes power.

p: A plant's average hides the difference between a high clinker and a blended cement. Choosing the blended one may be the cheapest cut in a building's footprint.
Tonnes from delivery notes times the per tonne figure gives your purchased goods emissions for the job.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, raw material and electricity invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per plant, so the clinker and cement figures can be traced back to the documents behind them.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
